description: Machine-readable catalogue of every dataset published by phd-demographics.andy-barr.com. Generated from the data at build time.
license: Public domain federal data. Attribution appreciated.

stem_universities.description: STEM thesis and dissertation records by university

nonstem_universities.description: Non-STEM thesis and dissertation records by university

exports.description: Columnar exports. These are the tables the SQL console at /query loads, and they can be queried directly with DuckDB from this URL.

built_datasets.description: Built datasets. Each is produced by one script in scripts/ from the federal source named in source_url, and every figure on the site is read from one of these at render time.

files.summary: The 49 institution-and-field cells that are sustainedly majority non-resident. Drives the landing-page hero.
files.source: derived

files.summary: Five industries the country cannot offshore -- mining, petroleum, aerospace, battery technology and nuclear -- by non-resident share of the research doctorates that staff them, with the programmes and institutions behind each.
files.source: NCES IPEDS Completions, research doctorates by CIP and citizenship

files.summary: The Data Asks page: what the federal government holds or once published that would answer a question this site cannot.
files.source: derived
files.cadence: when an ask is added, or when a dataset it cites changes shape

files.summary: National department histogram by non-resident share, 2010/2015/2020/2025, at 4-digit CIP.
files.source: derived

files.summary: The 40 largest countries of origin of temporary-visa doctorate recipients, and parental education by citizenship.
files.source: NSF NCSES, Survey of Earned Doctorates 2024, tables 7-8 and 5-5

files.summary: What US-trained doctorate holders earn and where they work, by citizenship AT THE DOCTORATE, and what became of those on a temporary visa.
files.source: NSF NCSES, Survey of Doctorate Recipients 2023 public-use file

files.summary: Domestic core-STEM completions by level 2011-2025, and the rate at which a bachelor's cohort is followed by graduate degrees.
files.source: NCES IPEDS Completions

files.summary: One row per employer: H-1B petitions requested, granted and denied, the wage level promised, and any enforcement findings.
files.source: Joined from h1b_approvals, lca_wage_levels and h1b_enforcement

files.summary: Temporary-visa share of graduate enrolment joined to federal R&D expenditure -- whether the public money and the foreign enrolment sit in the same institutions.
files.source: NSF NCSES GSS 2024 and HERD FY2024 table 14

files.summary: The employment route that needs no visa: which employer-of-record vendors reference each other, how many country pages each publishes, and the pages whose own address names the H-1B.
files.source: Employer-of-record vendors' own published sitemaps
files.cadence: on demand; the vendors republish continuously

files.summary: Non-resident graduate degrees and visa issuances on one time axis, in named windows -- when each part of the pipeline expanded, and in what order.
files.source: Derived from graduate_balance and visa_issuances

files.summary: The employer-side payroll-tax differential on OPT employment, as a rate and as a labelled scenario grid.
files.source: IRC 3121(b)(19) and IRS guidance; DHS SEVP authorisation counts
files.cadence: on statute change or a new SEVP release

files.summary: Full-time doctoral support by mechanism and, within federal support, by funding agency -- whose money pays for graduate study, across 653 institutions.
files.source: NSF NCSES, Survey of Graduate Students and Postdoctorates, 2024

files.summary: Non-resident share of core-STEM degrees at master's level, doctorate level and the two combined, across thirty years -- where in graduate education the balance actually shifted.
files.source: NCES IPEDS Completions, 1995-2025

files.summary: Non-resident share of graduate enrolment, all fields, 2010-2023 -- an independent read on the degree series.
files.source: NCES IPEDS Fall Enrolment (EF), 2010-2023

files.summary: How many credentials the United States awards each year in the programmes that staff generation, transmission and the electrical trade -- counts rather than shares, because this workforce is already almost entirely domestic and the question is its size. 62 power plant technology credentials nationally in 2025, at five institutions.
files.source: NCES IPEDS Completions, all award levels, 2000-2025

files.summary: Forty years of science, engineering and health graduate and postdoctoral enrolment by citizenship, 1980-2024 -- the long STEM-specific view.
files.source: NSF NCSES, Survey of Graduate Students and Postdoctorates, table 1-7

files.summary: Full-time S&E&H graduate enrolment by institution and the temporary-visa share of it, master's and doctoral, ranked.
files.source: NSF NCSES, Survey of Graduate Students and Postdoctorates, 2024

files.summary: H-1B petitions approved and denied by employer, FY2009-2023 -- what USCIS actually granted, between what employers asked for and what enforcement later found.
files.source: USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub

files.summary: Certified LCAs by six-digit NAICS. Six digits separates a staffing firm from a law firm; the USCIS hub's two cannot.
files.source: US DOL OFLC LCA disclosure files

files.summary: Certified LCAs by SOC occupation: the custodial, food-service and personal-care roles as well as the professorships.
files.source: US DOL OFLC LCA disclosure files

files.summary: H-1B wage violations found by the Department of Labor, 2000-2026: cases, back wages, employees and employers.
files.source: US DOL Wage and Hour Division enforcement database (WHISARD)

files.summary: Refugee arrivals 1980-2023 and asylum grants by nationality -- the humanitarian route, for scale against the study and work routes.
files.source: DHS Yearbook of Immigration Statistics, refugee and asylee tables

files.summary: State and federal appropriations received by each public institution, so a campus's non-resident share can sit beside the public money going into it.
files.source: NCES IPEDS Finance, GASB form (F1A)
files.cadence: annual, with the IPEDS finance release

files.summary: One row per institution on a single UNITID key -- core-STEM master's and doctorates with their non-resident shares, graduate enrolment, federal R&D and obligations, tuition -- with national rankings on each measure and a rollup to states.
files.source: IPEDS Completions, Fall Enrollment, Institutional Characteristics and Directory; NSF HERD FY2024; NSF Federal Support Survey FY2023; NSF GSS 2024

files.summary: Prevailing-wage level promised on certified H-1B filings, by employer, FY2019 and FY2023 -- what was promised, beside what enforcement later found.
files.source: US DOL Office of Foreign Labor Certification, H-1B LCA disclosure data

files.summary: Non-resident share rankings at BOTH master's and doctoral level: by institution, by 4-digit CIP, fastest risers, largest cohorts, and the within-institution contrast.
files.source: derived
files.cadence: after a new Completions year lands

files.summary: Everything the live voice dashboard renders, in one ~9 KB file so no chart update touches the network.
files.source: derived

files.summary: The below-median finding measured against the median for the occupation in the worksite state, not the national one.
files.source: BLS OEWS state file and US DOL OFLC LCA disclosure data
files.cadence: quarterly, with OFLC and annually with OEWS

files.summary: Core-STEM doctorates 1995-2025: totals, non-resident and domestic counts, share, and the by-field breakdown.
files.source: derived

files.summary: Permanent residence by class and by type -- adjustment of status against new arrival. How many green cards go to people already in the country on a temporary visa.
files.source: DHS Office of Homeland Security Statistics, Yearbook of Immigration Statistics, table 6

files.summary: The entry point for the thesis and dissertation name lists, and the counts behind it: records, universities, departments and the year range.
files.source: derived from the harvested thesis and dissertation records

files.summary: Employment by occupation and median weekly earnings, split by nativity -- the domestic side of the ledger.
files.source: BLS Current Population Survey, foreign-born workers news release
files.cadence: annual, with the BLS foreign-born release

files.summary: Admissions by class of admission and year, FY2014-2023, with destination state -- the closest substitute for the L-1 and O-1 employer data that is not published.
files.source: DHS Yearbook of Immigration Statistics, nonimmigrant tables

files.summary: Annual wage percentiles by detailed occupation -- the denominator that prices the H-1B wage levels in dollars.
files.source: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, national files 2019-2024

files.summary: Permanent residents by country of last residence against country of birth -- which countries are waypoints rather than sources.
files.source: DHS Yearbook of Immigration Statistics, tables 2 and 3

files.summary: Postdoctoral appointees by citizenship and by federal support, per institution, including the nine universities named in the 2026-10-08 J-1 investigation.
files.source: NSF NCSES Survey of Graduate Students and Postdoctorates, 2024

files.summary: Every certified permanent-residence filing by a university, a school district or a state agency, with the worker's citizenship, birth country and the visa held when the employer filed.
files.source: US DOL OFLC PERM disclosure files, FY2013-FY2024

files.summary: Publishes eighteen analysis files that their own builders write beside their inputs rather than into site/data/.
files.source: Derived: copies of analysis files built elsewhere in the repo
files.cadence: rebuild after any of the source builders

files.summary: The government's own list of China-related prosecutions, parsed from the archived DOJ page, with each defendant's role read from DOJ's own headline; plus the cases charged after that list stopped being updated.
files.source: US Department of Justice, National Security Division -- archived China Initiative case compilation, plus individual US Attorney press releases
files.cadence: never -- the source list was frozen on 19 November 2021

files.summary: Every page, title, description and anchor, walked from the actual HTML so the assistant's page list cannot drift.
files.source: derived
files.cadence: after any page is added, renamed or re-sectioned

files.summary: Which arms of state government sponsor H-1B workers, and for what: approvals by agency and state, with the job titles and wages from the employer's own certified applications.
files.source: USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub, plus US DOL OFLC LCA disclosure files for job titles and wages
files.cadence: annual, as USCIS republishes the Data Hub

files.summary: H-1B filings by agencies of state government.
files.source: USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub and DOL LCA disclosure files

files.summary: State appropriations per FTE against the non-resident share of graduate enrolment at public institutions, by state, 2010-2023 -- a test of why the tuition finding exists.
files.source: SHEEO State Higher Education Finance FY2024, and NCES IPEDS Fall Enrolment

files.summary: In-state against out-of-state at public four-year institutions in each state: the split of full-time-equivalent enrolment, and the net tuition and fee revenue collected per student from each group.
files.source: SHEEO State Higher Education Finance, student residency data, FY2020-FY2024

files.summary: The state list the sidebar expands under All State Profiles.
files.source: derived

files.summary: Where temporary-visa S&E doctorate recipients actually live years after graduating: 73% of the 2017-19 cohort were still in the US in 2023.
files.source: NCSES NSF 25-325, Table 1

files.summary: Median earnings and debt one year after completion, by 4-digit CIP and credential level -- the only federal source that prices a STEM degree by field AND level.
files.source: U.S. Department of Education, College Scorecard field of study file

files.summary: The headline figure from every finding, in one file, each with the dataset and path it was read from and the limit on how it may be read.
files.source: Derived from this project's own published datasets
files.cadence: rebuild whenever any source dataset is rebuilt

files.summary: Primary source of support by citizenship. The allocation evidence: 76.0% of international S&E doctorate recipients are on assistantships against 53.1% of citizens.
files.source: NSF Survey of Earned Doctorates, Table 4-1

files.summary: Seven years of primary source of doctoral support by citizenship, 2018-2024 -- how long the assistantship gap has held, and which way it is moving.
files.source: NSF NCSES, Survey of Earned Doctorates, primary-source-of-support table, 2018-2024 releases

files.summary: Federal obligations per STEM research doctorate, against non-resident share. Quantifies the public-investment claim.
files.source: derived (NSF NCSES Federal Support Survey + IPEDS)

files.summary: What the core-STEM master's expansion is worth in tuition: published out-of-state graduate rates against non-resident master's degrees conferred, with the audited sector total alongside, in constant 2024 dollars.
files.source: derived
files.cadence: annually, when IPEDS IC and finance files are released

files.summary: Published in-state tuition at public institutions beside state appropriations per FTE, 2000-2023, in constant dollars -- what students were charged as states changed what they put in.
files.source: NCES IPEDS Institutional Characteristics, SHEEO SHEF, and BLS CPI-U

files.summary: Tuition as a share of institutional revenue against the foreign share of graduate enrolment, public and private reported separately.
files.source: NCES IPEDS Finance FY2023-24, and NSF NCSES GSS 2024

files.summary: Per-university department distributions: every 4-digit CIP programme with 15+ doctorates, 2015-2022, with its share.
files.source: derived

files.summary: Non-resident enrolment by institution, with SEVP's top campuses by STEM OPT authorisation beside it.
files.source: NCES IPEDS Fall Enrolment and DHS SEVP top-campus tables

files.summary: Which H-1B employers supply workers to other companies, from the employers' own certified filings: six-digit industry, the H-1B-dependency answer, third-party placement, and the wage tier they chose -- plus the same-occupation wage gap between placed and directly-hired positions.
files.source: US Department of Labor, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, H-1B Labor Condition Application disclosure files
files.cadence: quarterly, as OFLC publishes disclosure files

files.summary: Employment-based final action dates FY1992-2023 for India, China, the Philippines and all other countries -- the employer-dependence argument in years.
files.source: US Department of State, Visa Bulletin historical final action dates

files.summary: Nonimmigrant visa issuances by class and nationality, 1997-2024 -- the entry point, counted at the consulate.
files.source: US Department of State, Nonimmigrant Visa Detail Tables, FY1997-2024
files.cadence: annual, with the State Department detail tables

files.summary: Every US institution with 100+ graduate students where non-residents are half or more of them: 57 in fall 2024, up from 43 in 2022, with their federal student aid and the recruitment payments the nonprofits report to the IRS.
files.source: NCES IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2022-2024, Institutional Characteristics directory 2024 and Student Financial Aid 2022-23; IRS Form 990 e-file returns
files.cadence: annual, with IPEDS Fall Enrolment and the IRS 990 release

files.summary: Every H-1B employer USCIS names, fiscal 2009-2023: 368,825 of them and 1,675,026 initial approvals, with how concentrated the programme is, the same firm's several filing names collapsed into one, and the debarred employers that appear.
files.source: USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub; US Department of Labor debarment lists
files.cadence: annual, when USCIS refreshes the hub

files.summary: Visa issuance by class, student work authorisations and the H-1B denial rate on one timeline, 2007-2024, with the dated federal actions that restricted or expanded each.
files.source: US Department of State Nonimmigrant Visa Detail Tables; DHS SEVP OPT/STEM OPT/CPT; USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub; Federal Register

files.summary: Share of certified H-1B filings at each prevailing-wage level, by fiscal year -- whether employers have moved toward the bottom of the legal range or away from it.
files.source: US DOL OFLC, H-1B LCA disclosure archive FY2017-2026

files.summary: Hours worked and reported satisfaction by CURRENT citizenship status -- whether visa dependence shows up in what people work and report, not only in the statute.
files.source: NSF NCSES, Survey of Doctorate Recipients 2023 public-use file

record_schema.description: Each university JSON holds a records array. Each record is a positional array: department, year, name, origin_class, confidence, title, url, degree_type

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department or field of study, normalised via the taxonomy

fields.name: name
fields.description: Author, as the awarding repository recorded it, with catalogue artefacts removed

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title of the thesis or dissertation, truncated to 90 characters

fields.name: url
fields.description: Link to the record in the awarding university's repository
